profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, trading under the ticker XPEV and registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under CIK 0001810997. Its Spanish site presents the XPENG range as fully electric under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo," and the company says it has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014.

The models described on the site are the G6, G9 and P7⁺. The company says these combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the 800-volt SEPA 2.0 electric platform, which it says allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160.000 km.

The Spanish site names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the data controller for enquiries submitted through it, and states that financing is offered by Open Bank, S.A. Among the terms listed are a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 € for the G6 RWD Standard Range over 36 months at a T.A.E. of 3,53%, and a cash price of 56.590,30€ for the G9 RWD Standard Range at a T.A.E. of 6,76%. No litigation involving the company appears in the material.
